def shape_cells(rows, cs, ce):
    return [(r,c) for r in range(rows[0],rows[1]+1) for c in range(cs,ce+1) if True]
# detect shape pattern from top-left shape of demo input
def groups(g):
    # find horizontal groups of shapes separated by all-zero rows
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    rowsactive=[any(v!=0 and v!=3 for v in row) for row in g]
    grps=[];cur=None
    for i,a in enumerate(rowsactive):
        if a and cur is None: cur=i
        if not a and cur is not None: grps.append((cur,i-1)); cur=None
    if cur is not None: grps.append((cur,h-1))
    return grps
def shapes_in(g,r0,r1):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # columns active within band
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if any(g[i][j] not in (0,3) for i in range(r0,r1+1))]
    # cluster with gap>1
    shps=[];cur=[cols[0]]
    for j in cols[1:]:
        if j-cur[-1]<=1: cur.append(j)
        else: shps.append((cur[0],cur[-1]));cur=[j]
    shps.append((cur[0],cur[-1]))
    return shps

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    # shape pattern: normalize from first shape of first group
    grps=groups(g)
    r0,r1=grps[0]
    cs,ce=shapes_in(g,r0,r1)[0]
    pat=[[(i-r0,j-cs) for j in range(w) if 0<=i<h and g[i][j] not in(0,3) and cs<=j<=ce] for i in range(r0,r1+1)]
    patc=[row for row in pat if row]
    # rows of pattern: sorted by row index; cell cols per pattern row
    prows={}
    for i in range(r1-r0+1):
        cells=sorted(j-cs for j in range(w) if g[r0+i][j] not in (0,3) and cs<=j<cs+(ce-cs+1))
        if cells: prows[i]=cells
    # per group: match count to a pattern row
    info=[]
    for (a,b) in grps:
        shs=shapes_in(g,a,b)
        n=len(shs)
        row=[k for k,v in prows.items() if len(v)==n]
        assert len(row)==1,(a,b,n,row)
        info.append((a,b,shs,row[0]))
    used={r for _,_,_,r in info}
    missing=[k for k in prows if k not in used]
    assert len(missing)==1
    mr=missing[0]
    # 3-block
    block=[i for i in range(h) if all(v==3 for v in g[i])]
    b0,b1=block[0],block[-1]
    # placement column: intersection of shape offsets across groups
    offs=[set(s[0] for s in shs) for _,_,shs,_ in info]
    common=set.intersection(*offs)
    # fallback: block start row
    oc = sorted(common)[0] if common else b0
    # clear block, draw shape at offset oc
    for i in range(b0,b1+1):
        g[i]=[0]*w
    for i in range(r1-r0+1):
        for j in prows.get(i,[]):
            g[b0+i][oc+j]=2
    # 8s
    for a,b,shs,pr in info:
        for k,(cs_,ce_) in enumerate(shs):
            g[a+pr][cs_+prows[pr][k]]=8
    # new shape 8 at missing row
    g[b0+mr][oc+prows[mr][0]]=8
    return g

    return g
